queries.sql: SELECT account_on_invoice, amount_minor FROM erp.invoices WHERE inv_id = ?
SELECT inv_id, issuer_name, account_on_invoice, amount_minor, po_ref FROM erp.invoices WHERE inv_id = ?
SELECT i.inv_id, i.notes, m.email_id, m.body FROM erp.invoices i LEFT JOIN mailbox m ON m.email_id = i.email_id WHERE i.inv_id = ?
SELECT i.inv_id, i.notes, m.email_id, m.body FROM erp.invoices i LEFT JOIN mailbox m ON m.email_id = i.email_id WHERE i.inv_id = ?

SELECT i.inv_id, i.issuer_name, i.issuer_reg_no, p.po_id, v.vendor_id, v.reg_no AS master_reg_no, v.legal_name, c.contract_id, c.vendor_reg_no AS contract_reg_no, c.jurisdiction FROM erp.invoices i JOIN erp.purchase_orders p ON p.po_id = i.po_ref JOIN vm.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id LEFT JOIN contracts c ON c.vendor_reg_no = v.reg_no AND c.item = p.item AND c.amendment_of IS NULL WHERE i.inv_id = ?
SELECT reg_no, legal_name, jurisdiction, incorporated_on FROM registry WHERE lower(legal_name) = lower(?)

SELECT i.inv_id, i.account_on_invoice, v.vendor_id, v.account AS master_account, c.contract_id, c.jurisdiction FROM erp.invoices i JOIN erp.purchase_orders p ON p.po_id = i.po_ref JOIN vm.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id LEFT JOIN contracts c ON c.vendor_reg_no = v.reg_no AND c.item = p.item AND c.amendment_of IS NULL WHERE i.inv_id = ?

SELECT change_id, vendor_id, field, new_value, requested_via, request_ref, callback_verified, changed_at FROM vm.vendor_changes WHERE vendor_id = ? AND field = 'account' AND CAST(changed_at AS STRING) >= ? ORDER BY changed_at DESC
SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, reg_no, added_at FROM vm.vendors WHERE account = ? AND vendor_id <> ?
SELECT email_id, from_domain, received_at FROM mailbox WHERE contains(body, ?) ORDER BY received_at LIMIT 1

SELECT i.inv_id, i.unit_price_minor AS inv_price, c.contract_id, c.unit_price_minor AS contract_price FROM erp.invoices i JOIN erp.purchase_orders p ON p.po_id = i.po_ref JOIN vm.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id LEFT JOIN contracts c ON c.vendor_reg_no = v.reg_no AND c.item = p.item  AND CAST(c.valid_from AS STRING) <= CAST(i.received_at AS STRING)  AND CAST(c.valid_to AS STRING) >= CAST(i.received_at AS STRING) WHERE i.inv_id = ? ORDER BY c.valid_from DESC

SELECT i.inv_id, i.qty AS inv_qty, p.po_id, p.qty AS po_qty, g.gr_id, g.qty AS gr_qty FROM erp.invoices i JOIN erp.purchase_orders p ON p.po_id = i.po_ref LEFT JOIN erp.goods_receipts g ON g.po_id = p.po_id WHERE i.inv_id = ?
SELECT i.*, p.vendor_id, p.item AS po_item, p.qty AS po_qty FROM erp.invoices i JOIN erp.purchase_orders p ON p.po_id = i.po_ref WHERE i.inv_id = ?

SELECT o.inv_id, o.amount_minor, o.po_ref, pay.pay_id, pay.paid_at FROM erp.invoices o JOIN erp.payments pay ON pay.inv_id = o.inv_id WHERE o.inv_id <> ? AND (o.po_ref = ? OR ? LIKE CONCAT(o.inv_id, '%'))
